# School Climate

> The National School Climate Center provides comprehensive assessment tools and implementation support for K-12 leaders to measure and improve school climate through data-driven approaches.

School Climate is the official platform of the National School Climate Center (NSCC), dedicated to helping educational leaders understand and enhance their school environments. The organization offers the Comprehensive School Climate Inventory (CSCI), a validated assessment tool used by schools across the country to measure climate and drive improvement initiatives.

## Key Topics

- National School Climate Center (NSCC)
- Comprehensive School Climate Inventory (CSCI)
- School climate assessment
- Climate measurement
- K-12 school improvement
- Data-to-action framework
- School climate survey
- Implementation support
- School environment measurement
- Educational leadership
- Climate-based school improvement

## Assessment & Measurement Tools

- [NSCC Services Portal](https://services.schoolclimate.org): NSCC services portal featuring the CSCI assessment tool for comprehensive school climate measurement and data analysis
